name: bboxy design system
owner: operator (bboxy450); written by Lumen Foxglove <CREATIVITY> from the lab
principles: every pixel is precious: no outer padding, 2 px gutters, chrome takes no space it does not use
one material, one radius scale, one type scale, one spacing grid, one motion curve
colour means identity only (seat, swarm, role); state is glyph and glow; selection is a tint
one signal per meaning, one meaning per signal; nothing animates without a cause
click changes what you see; hover only highlights (panes may take focus on dwell)
a swarm is a world: its own seats, tabs, shadows, stream, panes
rows never reorder; nothing in the sidebar moves on focus
destructive actions are reversible by a window, not a dialog

material.frosted: surface at 78% with 30 px blur and 1.4 saturate for panels; 72% for cards
material.edges: hairline = line at 70%; never a solid border except pane borders (identity)
material.highlight: inset 1 px top highlight at 8% white on panels
material.shadow: only under floating things (panel, pill, ghost); cards and rows cast none

type.family: system sans; mono for digits, keys, paths

ground.sidebar: sidebar (lighter than bg in dark, darker in light)

identity.seat: hash of key → 36 hues × 2 lightness bands, operator override
identity.swarm: random from key, swatch cycles it

motion.cell_breathe: 1.2 s on a lit preview cell

theme.toggle: one icon in the title bar: sun in dark, moon in light
theme.light_glow: halo darkens toward the seat colour instead of adding light

border_glow.sidebar_budget: radius 4, 30% alpha, particles only when active, none when idle

locate.stage_switch: fires after the new screen renders

unread_dot.means: a message for this seat is unread

presence_notice.where: centred line in the swarm stream

hover.panes: tint, then dwell focus after 150 ms (blocked 1 s after typing)

dim.panes: strip and content desaturate 0.10, opacity 0.45, background wash 28%; border keeps the seat colour
dim.swarms: same tokens on band and rows; bumper keeps the colour

state_grade.drawing: reported = solid glyph; shim = solid with a thin ring; inferred = hollow or dashed glyph; the glow follows the glyph (inferred glows at half alpha)

waiting_kind.drawing: three variants of ◐: permission = ◐ with a key dot, question = ◐ with a ?, auth = ◐ with a lock; amber for all; the strip subtitle names the kind

delivery_evidence.source: messaging.md: sender-stored, recipient-stored, native-queued, native-written, native-unknown, application-acknowledged
delivery_evidence.drawing: a tick ladder at the right of a message row: ·  ✓  ✓✓  ✓✓✓ for stored → written → acknowledged; unknown is a distinct hollow mark, never red, never a failure

held_count.drawing: muted row shows a small "held N" badge after the muted mark; unmute clears it

restarted_notice.drawing: one-shot "restarted" chip on the row for 4 s, then a stream line

pending_row.means: the Oracle is spawning this seat
pending_row.source: MCP mutation status accepted | applied | rejected | unknown
pending_row.drawing: a dashed-outline row with a rolled name and a spinner glyph until applied; rejected shows the reason in a closed-strip-like row; unknown stays dashed

interrupt_signal.means: the Oracle or operator stopped the seat
interrupt_signal.drawing: a brief red bar sweep across the strip, then the state glyph; stream line "interrupted by …"

tile.anatomy: radius.tile square in the harness colour, white glyph

badge.anatomy: radius.badge square, badge tint, mono digits

kbd.anatomy: mono, badge tint, radius 5, inside pills and legends

glyph.anatomy: ● ○ ◐ ✕ at density.glyph, coloured by state; active takes the seat colour

swatch.anatomy: 10 px circle in the colour with a white ring; click cycles

pill.anatomy: radius.pill, panel material, shadow.pill, label · kbd pairs with thin separators

crumb.purpose: where you are inside a nested list
crumb.anatomy: selection-tinted chip with a trailing ›, before the input

chevron.anatomy: › at the right edge of a parent row, replacing the number

band.anatomy: 24 px gloss band in the swarm colour, tracked uppercase, count, swatch; set into the card top
band.hover: lightens its own colour, never white

bumper.purpose: carry the swarm colour at the bottom
bumper.anatomy: 4 px solid strip, 3 px when shut

close_dot.anatomy: macOS red dot at the left of the strip; greys when unfocused; × on hover

mute_toggle.anatomy: speaker icon in the strip before the glyph; lit amber when muted

muted_mark.anatomy: small amber muted icon after the name; name at 70%

mini_grid.purpose: the split tree of a tab
mini_grid.anatomy: nested cells with real ratios; focused cell accent; waiting and errored cells tinted; single-seat tabs show none

ghost.anatomy: pill with the seat name in the seat colour following the pointer

drop_zone.anatomy: the hovered half of a pane tinted with selection; also used by ⌘D previews (breathing)

divider.anatomy: the 2 px gutter with an 8 px grab zone; col/row-resize cursor; nothing drawn

cursor.anatomy: block cursor at the end of the focused pane's text, blinking 1 Hz; static elsewhere

gap_marker.anatomy: a hairline across the pane body with a centred caption "… N lines not retained"

stop_action.anatomy: a square stop glyph in the strip next to the mute toggle; hidden for worker roles

listener_count.purpose: external clients on the seat socket
listener_count.anatomy: a tiny plug glyph with a count at the row's right when > 0

where_mark.anatomy: a prefix before the harness tile on rows and strips: cloud glyph for cloud seats, server glyph for ssh seats, nothing for local; tooltip names the host

title_bar.purpose: the window's one set of controls
title_bar.anatomy: three window dots · sidebar toggle · portrait mark · app name · crumb (swarm · seat) · spacer · theme icon
rules: no second set of dots anywhere
one theme icon, no label, no cycle

sidebar.anatomy: swarm cards stacked, new-swarm button, stream dock at the bottom

swarm_card.anatomy: card material · band · tab rows · seat rows · closed strips · new-seat row · Shadows group · bumper

states.shut: band only, roll-up glyphs worst-first (max 6), waiting badge

rules: double-click the band renames; a new swarm is born with its name field open

seat_row.anatomy: tile · name (seat colour) · role mark · muted mark · title · ⌘N badge · glyph
rules: click focuses and locates its pane

tab_row.anatomy: name · roll-up glyphs when collapsed · ⌘N badge · mini-grid
rules: single-seat tabs render as their seat row with no grid

new_seat_row.anatomy: + new seat · ⌘T badge; last seat row of every open swarm
rules: present in every open swarm so nothing jiggles

closed_strip.purpose: a seat in grace after close
closed_strip.anatomy: × · grey tile · struck name · countdown · undo ⌘Z
rules: undo or ⌘Z restores in place with its split position

shadows_group.purpose: other people's harnesses in this swarm's channels
shadows_group.anatomy: section label Shadows · grey seat rows with state glyph and grey breathing glow
rules: a message pulses the row once
shadows_group.status: deferred with global messaging; module kept

rules: new swarm starts with one zsh seat and opens its name field

stream_dock.anatomy: last four messages as rows (role rail · <ROLE> · text · time · unread dot) and centred presence notices; filter chip when a shadow is selected
rules: foreign Oracle gets no priority chip

pane.anatomy: strip · body · border in the seat colour

states.focused: full contrast, blinking cursor, glow boosted

rules: click focuses and bounces its row
drag by the strip to move

title_strip.anatomy: 22 px in the seat colour: close dot · tile-less harness icon · name · role mark · title · ⌘N badge · mute toggle · glyph
rules: same drawing as the row so the mapping is instant

banner.purpose: say what the launcher will do
banner.anatomy: panel material above the modal: large diagram · big title · subtitle

variants.split: real pane layout with the new cell breathing: Split right / Split down · of <seat>
variants.new_tab: the swarm's tab strip with a new lit tab: New tab · in <swarm>

glow_canvas.anatomy: one full-window WebGL2 pass above the DOM, premultiplied alpha, zero layout space
glow_canvas.budget: evaluate only rects whose halo reaches the pixel; sidebar rows on a smaller budget

reconnect_overlay.anatomy: the stale frame stays, dimmed with the dim tokens, under a centred pill "reconnecting…" with a spinner; the glow freezes; on reconnect the frame redraws and the pill fades

row_menu.purpose: per-seat actions that are not worth a strip icon
row_menu.anatomy: right-click or ⌘-click a row: Assign role ▸, Permissions ▸, Copy socket path, Mute/Unmute, Interrupt, Close
rules: Oracle/operator only for role, permissions, interrupt

launcher_cap_notice.anatomy: launch rows dim and the banner subtitle reads "swarm at its cap (N) · close or raise the cap"; Go to still works

purge_modal.purpose: skip grace, terminate, delete ring and checkpoints
purge_modal.source: mcp-control-plane purge decision: GUI only, never MCP
purge_modal.anatomy: the launcher material, red title, the seat name must be typed to enable the button
rules: the one place a confirm dialog exists, because it is irreversible

audit_lines.purpose: the Oracle's actions in the open
audit_lines.source: Oracle audit log as a stream kind
audit_lines.anatomy: centred lines in the swarm stream like presence notices: "Oracle spawned X", "Oracle closed X", "Oracle interrupted X"

first_run.anatomy: one screen in the launcher material: create the root key, show the 24-word paper recovery once with a typed confirmation, then the window

settings_tab.anatomy: the lab settings page, read-mostly: values shown, edit opens the file; harness cards stay
settings_tab.status: lab page exists, read-mostly rule new

nested_subagent_rows.purpose: a harness's subagents under its seat row
nested_subagent_rows.anatomy: optional per harness: indented rows with description and working/idle glyph; absent when the harness gives nothing

modal.name: launcher
modal.purpose: one place to launch, place and go: harnesses and shells now, browser tabs, vnc and ssh later

opens_from.⌘D: split right of the focused seat (banner: layout)

anatomy: backdrop: window dimmed 35% and blurred 14 px
panel: 760 px, radius.panel, panel material, shadow.floating, hairline ring, inner highlight, appears in 160 ms
input row: crumbs · 22 px search field
rows: tile · title · subtitle · kind · number badge or chevron
footer: colour swatch · rolled name · reroll · action pill

rows.launchable: a harness or shell; Enter launches with the default placement; → opens its placements
rows.placement: New tab / Split right / Split down under a launchable
rows.goto: a parent row opening to every seat and swarm
rows.seat: name · swarm · title; Enter focuses with locate
rows.swarm: name · seat count in the swarm colour; Enter opens and jumps
rows.remote: SSH ▸ machine (from ~/.ssh/config) ▸ harness ▸ placement; Cloud ▸ region ▸ harness ▸ placement; the launched seat carries where + host

keyboard.←: climb out when the field is empty
keyboard.Backspace: climb out when the field is empty
keyboard.↵: pick; on a parent without a default, dive
keyboard.⌥↵: new tab instead of the preset split
keyboard.1-9: pick the nth visible row when the field is empty

typing.filter: label prefix, any word, subtitle, id
typing.flatten: "<parent> <rest>" filters inside the parent: goto nyx, go nyx, codex split, ssh codex, cloud claude, ssh rig codex

rules: the banner says what will happen before Enter; with a split preset the target half of the pane behind breathes too
the chosen seat is placed, focused, located, and its cursor blinks; the native app warps the pointer to the pane centre
rows are data: adding a launchable or a destination is a row, not new UI
demo keys (1-4, M, P) are suspended while the modal is open
the list never scrolls the window; the panel scrolls
the name is rolled from the fantasy / sci-fi / furry pools; reroll never changes the choice

matching.purpose: typing finds the thing you mean, not the string you typed
tiers: 1 prefix: label words and aliases (goto, go, jump; harness ids)
2 facets: every item carries tags; seats carry harness, where (local|ssh|cloud), host, role, state, swarm, muted; "codex", "ssh", "cloud", "oracle", "waiting" filter Go to by facet
4 fuzzy: subsequence on the label for words of 3+ letters ("nyxc" → Nyx Copperwing)

5 semantic (real app only): the Jev encoder embeds every row (label + subtitle + tags) once and the query per keystroke; cosine over 384-d vectors; rows above 0.55 join the list below the lexical tiers; also re-ranks ties
matching.words: typed words are ANDed: "codex ssh" = Codex seats over ssh; a word that names a parent descends instead (ssh rig codex)
matching.ranking: tier of the first word, then original order; the list never jumps on a keystroke beyond what the tier change requires

jev.what: the local small neural encoder ICQ ships for `icq how`: pocket-encoder/minilm-l3-q4-g32-v1, 384 dimensions, attention-masked mean pooling, L2 normalised, 128 tokens, no daemon, no network, no download
jev.use_in_launcher: embed each row text once when the list is built (seats change rarely); embed the query on each keystroke after a 40 ms debounce; cosine against all rows; merge with lexical tiers by reciprocal rank fusion; show at most 5 semantic-only rows under a "Related" section so lexical hits stay on top
use_elsewhere: Go to by meaning: "the one doing the gpu research" → Rook
stream search: find messages by meaning across a swarm
command palette later: verbs by meaning ("shut this" → close seat)
sidebar Shadows and stream ordering by relevance to the focused seat, opt-in
jev.limits: queries over 128 tokens truncate; names from the fantasy / sci-fi / furry pools are out of vocabulary for the encoder, so names stay lexical (tier 1) and semantic covers titles, roles, states and messages
jev.cost: one forward pass per keystroke on a 3-layer MiniLM; sub-millisecond on M-series; rows cached

ordering.what: with an empty field, rows are ordered by closeness to the context, not by a fixed list
ordering.context_vector: the focused seat (name, title, harness, role, state, where), the swarm name, the last three launcher picks, the last three stream messages, and the time since the seat last changed state; embedded as one short text, refreshed when any of those change
ordering.suggestions_section: the top three rows by cosine to the context vector become the Suggestions section; the rest keep their section order; a row never moves within its section on a keystroke
examples: focused seat is a waiting Codex over ssh → Suggestions: Go to ▸ that seat, SSH ▸ rig ▸ Codex, Split right
last three picks were cloud launches → Cloud rises above SSH
stream is full of gpu talk → the gpu-research seat rises in Go to
ordering.with_a_query: lexical tiers decide membership; Jev breaks ties inside a tier and orders the Related section
ordering.frequency_is_not_jev: plain counts order placements (if you mostly split right, Split right is first); Jev orders by meaning, counts order by habit; counts win inside a tier when both apply
ordering.never: reorder while the user is holding a key or within 300 ms of the last keystroke; reorder rows the user can reach by number keys without re-numbering them

interactions.focus: click a row or a pane; Tab / Shift+Tab across panes; pane dwell 150 ms; a seat in another tab or swarm switches the stage; open/shut of swarms is separate
interactions.locate: directional: row click → pane ring; pane click → row bounce; keyboard → both; after a stage switch too
interactions.split: launcher ⌘↵ / ⌘⇧↵, ⌘D / ⌘⇧D presets, placements sublist, or drag a row or strip onto a pane half (50/50); dragged seats move
interactions.close: red dot → 60 s grace strip → undo / ⌘Z restores in place; then gone
interactions.mute: ⌘M or strip toggle; muted mark; presence notices on mute and unmute
interactions.rename_swarm: double-click the band; Enter commits, Escape cancels
interactions.message: unread dot on the row; stream dock; shadow pulse once
interactions.theme: one icon flips light and dark; OS sets the start
interactions.assign_role: row menu, Oracle/operator; the role mark changes in place
interactions.permissions: row menu, Oracle/operator; which channels and DMs the seat may send to
interactions.interrupt: stop action in the strip or row menu; Oracle/operator; interrupt signal

gaps: settings page and toolbar icon exist as lab pages, not wired into the showcase
the lab cannot warp the OS pointer; native only
17 spec implications are drawn in this file with status "drawn, not built"; each is one lab pass
machine and region lists are demo values; the real app reads ~/.ssh/config and the cloud account
